name: Taj Mahal
shortDescription: One of the Seven Wonders of the World and a timeless symbol of love.
description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river in Agra. Built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal, it is India's most iconic monument and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Golden Temple
shortDescription: Amritsar's luminous spiritual heart and Sikhism's holiest shrine.
description: Harmandir Sahib, known as the Golden Temple, is the most sacred gurdwara of Sikhism. Its gold-plated structure reflects in the Amrit Sarovar, welcoming millions of visitors of all faiths.

name: Jaipur — Pink City
shortDescription: Forts, palaces, and royal Rajasthani heritage in the Pink City.
description: Jaipur, capital of Rajasthan, is famous for Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, City Palace, and vibrant bazaars. Planned in the 18th century, it remains one of India's most visited heritage cities.

name: Manali
shortDescription: Himalayan hill station of snow peaks, valleys, and adventure.
description: Manali in Himachal Pradesh is a gateway to the Rohtang Pass and Solang Valley. Popular for trekking, paragliding, temples, and cool mountain air year-round.

name: Goa Beaches
shortDescription: Sun, sand, seafood, and Indo-Portuguese coastal culture.
description: Goa blends palm-lined beaches, nightlife, churches, and spice markets. From Calangute to Palolem, it is India's classic coastal holiday destination.

name: Statue of Unity
shortDescription: The world's tallest statue, honouring Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
description: Standing on the Narmada in Gujarat, the Statue of Unity is a modern engineering landmark with museums, viewing galleries, and landscaped gardens around Kevadia.

name: Gir National Park
shortDescription: The last natural home of the Asiatic lion.
description: Gir in Gujarat is India's only wild habitat of Asiatic lions. Safari trails, dry deciduous forests, and rich wildlife make it a top conservation destination.

name: Kerala Backwaters
shortDescription: Serene houseboat cruises through palm-fringed lagoons.
description: The Kerala backwaters around Alappuzha and Kumarakom form a network of lakes, canals, and rivers. Travellers explore by kettuvallam houseboats amid coconut groves and village life.

name: Varanasi Ghats
shortDescription: Ancient spiritual city on the sacred Ganges.
description: Varanasi is among the world's oldest living cities. Its riverfront ghats host rituals, aarti ceremonies, and a profound cultural experience along the Ganges.

name: Eiffel Tower
shortDescription: Paris's iron icon and the world's most visited paid monument.
description: Built for the 1889 Exposition Universelle, the Eiffel Tower defines the Paris skyline. Climb or take the lift for panoramic views of the Seine and the City of Light.

name: Colosseum
shortDescription: Rome's ancient amphitheatre and emblem of the empire.
description: The Flavian Amphitheatre once held gladiatorial contests for tens of thousands. Today it is a UNESCO site and a cornerstone of any visit to Rome.

name: Santorini
shortDescription: Whitewashed cliffs and caldera sunsets in the Aegean.
description: Santorini's volcanic caldera views, blue-domed churches, and villages like Oia and Fira make it one of Greece's most photographed islands.

name: Machu Picchu
shortDescription: Inca citadel high in the Peruvian Andes.
description: Machu Picchu is a 15th-century Inca site set on a mountain ridge above the Urubamba River. A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Seven Wonders.

name: Great Wall of China
shortDescription: Epic fortifications winding across northern China.
description: Sections near Beijing such as Badaling and Mutianyu welcome visitors to walk restored battlements with dramatic mountain scenery.

name: Tokyo
shortDescription: Neon megacity blending tradition and futuristic culture.
description: Japan's capital offers temples in Asakusa, crossings in Shibuya, cuisine from sushi to ramen, efficient transit, and endless neighbourhoods to explore.

name: Sydney Opera House
shortDescription: Harbour landmark and masterpiece of modern architecture.
description: On Bennelong Point, the Sydney Opera House hosts performances under its famous shells, with views across Circular Quay and the Harbour Bridge.

name: Grand Canyon
shortDescription: Vast layered canyon carved by the Colorado River.
description: Arizona's Grand Canyon National Park offers rim viewpoints, hiking trails, and some of the most dramatic geology on Earth.

name: Pyramids of Giza
shortDescription: Ancient Egyptian wonders on the edge of Cairo.
description: The Great Pyramid, Khafre, Menkaure, and the Sphinx form Egypt's most famous archaeological complex and a lasting symbol of the ancient world.

name: Bali
shortDescription: Island of temples, rice terraces, and tropical beaches.
description: Bali is Indonesia's cultural jewel — Ubud's rice fields, Uluwatu's cliffs, and beach towns like Seminyak draw travellers seeking nature and spirituality.

name: Dubai
shortDescription: Desert metropolis of skyscrapers, souks, and the Burj Khalifa.
description: Dubai combines futuristic towers, luxury malls, desert safaris, and traditional creek abra boats — a major hub for modern Middle East travel.
